changelog:
Massive UI overhaul, added custom styling
Photo Capture:
- See each student's last photo date and days since
- Sort by name, longest since last photo, or most recent
- Students never photographed now show in the list
- Amber/red highlighting for overdue photos (Settings > Photo Alert Days)
- Filter box, Compare with previous photo, Open in Drive
- Inactive students are hidden

Updates now show a progress bar.
Fixes: zoom label cut off, Recent Scans squashed.

If the app closes after this update, just reopen it.
